youtube.baslik: Where in the brain do ABR waves come from? #shorts
youtube.aciklama: ABR waves reflect brainstem stations: wave I arises from the auditory nerve, wave III from the cochlear nucleus, and wave V from where the lateral lemniscus reaches the inferior colliculus. The ABR does not show the thalamus or cortex.
youtube.kapanis_metni: Follow AIHEAR Audiology Academy for more quick facts.

instagram.kanca: Where in the brain do ABR waves come from?
bilgiler: Wave I arises from the end of the auditory nerve near the cochlea.
Wave III relates to the cochlear nucleus, wave V to the inferior colliculus area.
The ABR assesses only the brainstem, not the thalamus or cortex.
